data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 abstracts SRC_005's CRT solution by identifying that 4≡-3 mod 7 and 3≡-2 mod 5 share the structural form of residues expressible as (divisor - offset), but the offsets differ (-2 vs -3), so the unified constant-difference identity fails while the general CRT parametric solution succeeds. This relation is REFUTED IF the constant-difference shortcut is actually a correct application here (which would mean 18 is wrong and 33 is right — but 33 mod 7=5≠4 refutes that). The dependence is on SRC_003.
